payload.title: Publish invalidates exactly the pages it rewrote, in both URL forms, when invalidation is set to targeted
payload.description: Today publication.cache.invalidation is off or on for everything. Add a targeted mode that invalidates only the paths a single story publish rewrote (the story page and twin, the index and section pages that list it), with both /dir/ and /dir/index.html forms. Check that invalidation_paths_for is the code on the publish path and that the deployed Lambda includes it. A deploy never invalidates in targeted mode. The publish result reports three outcomes separately: pages written, projection, and invalidation (ok, failed with reason, or skipped by config); an invalidation failure must not look like a failed write. Default stays eventually consistent at one hour until a site opts in. Gherkin plus a unit test over the path list; document the cost (a typical publish touches under 10 paths).
